bootSequence: Apply helmet + cors (origin from CLIENT_URL env)
Register body parsers: express.json (10 MB), express.urlencoded
Register morgan logger (skipped in test env)
Dynamic import src/queues/processors/email.processor (starts BullMQ worker in-process)

endpoints.description: Register new account; sends verification email directly
Login with Google access token (idToken field)
Sends password reset link; sets 1-hour token
Resets password using token from email
Submit campaign creation request (multipart: thumbnail, media[], proofDocuments[])
List campaigns owned by current user (paginated)
Campaign detail with donations, updates, comments
Paginated donations for a campaign (SUCCESS only)
Post comment (requires prior donation to campaign)
Update campaign story/thumbnail (owner; pending status only)
Close campaign (owner; >=50% funded or deadline reached)
Post progress update (owner; multipart media files)
Make a donation (authenticated or anonymous); rate-limited 5/min
Paginated own donation history; filterable by status, startDate, endDate
Count of active users — NO authentication required; placed before authenticate middleware
Submit withdrawal request for a closed campaign

admin.note: All endpoints require JWT + admin role (authenticate + requireAdmin middleware)

endpoints.description: Approve or reject a campaign request
Suspend campaign; cancels pending withdrawals; notifies creator
Lift campaign suspension; restores ACTIVE status
Paginated transaction list for a campaign
Approve or reject withdrawal; approved sets COMPLETED + campaign WITHDRAWN

auth.service.ts.emailMode: DIRECT (bypasses queue for register, login, forgotPassword to avoid Redis timeout)

methods.register: Hash password, create User, send verification email directly, generate + store tokens
methods.login: Validate credentials, resend verification if unverified (direct email), generate + store tokens
methods.refreshToken: Verify refresh token against Redis, rotate token pair
methods.googleLogin: Upsert user from Google profile object, generate tokens
methods.googleLoginWithToken: Exchange Google access token via @googleapis/oauth2, delegates to googleLogin
methods.forgotPassword: Set reset token (1-hour TTL), send reset email directly
methods.resetPassword: Validate token, hash + save new password, clear reset fields
methods.changePassword: Validate current password, hash + save new password

methods.createRequest: KYC gate, create CampaignRequest, queue sendNewCampaignRequestEmail
methods.listCampaigns: Paginated list with Redis cache (5-min TTL, key = serialised query)
methods.getCampaignById: Cache-first; loads creator + donations + updates + comments relations; cache key campaign:v2:{id}
methods.updateCampaign: Owner + PENDING status guard, invalidate campaign cache
methods.closeCampaign: canClose guard (>=50% funded or deadline passed), set CLOSED
methods.getCampaignAnalytics: Returns chartData + recentDonations + totalDonors for owner
methods.getPublicActiveCampaigns: Delegates to listCampaigns forced to ACTIVE status
methods.createCampaignUpdate: Allowed statuses: ACTIVE, CLOSED, WITHDRAWN; notifies donors via queue if not draft

methods.createDonation: ACTIVE campaign guard, create Donation, updateRaisedAmount atomically, simulate payment SUCCESS, queue receipt + creator notification
methods.getCampaignDonations: SUCCESS status only; searchable by donor name

methods.updateProfile: Upload new avatar to S3, delete old avatar key, save fields
methods.addBankAccount: Duplicate accountNumber guard; unset other defaults if isDefault=true
methods.getBankAccounts: Ordered: default first, then createdAt DESC
methods.setDefaultBankAccount: Unset all others, set target as default

methods.createRequest: KYC gate, CLOSED campaign guard, pending-request duplicate guard, balance check vs totalPaid, resolve bank account (by bankAccountId or default), queue admin notification

methods.getDashboardStats: Aggregates campaignStats + donationStats + paidStats + user counts in parallel
methods.reviewCampaignRequest: Approve: creates Campaign (ACTIVE) + queues email; Reject: queues email; writes AuditLog
methods.suspendCampaign: Set SUSPENDED, cancel PENDING withdrawals, queue email, write AuditLog
methods.processWithdrawRequest: Approve -> COMPLETED + campaign WITHDRAWN; Reject -> REJECTED; queue email; write AuditLog
methods.resolveReport: Set RESOLVED + resolvedById/resolvedAt; reloads with relations

methods.get<T>(key): Returns parsed JSON value or null
methods.set(key, value, ttlSeconds?): Serialises JSON; uses SETEX if TTL provided
methods.flush(pattern): Deletes all keys matching glob pattern

methods.uploadFile(buffer, key, mimeType): Generic upload; returns public HTTPS URL

CampaignRepository.findWithPagination(page, limit, filters,: [Campaign[], number]; filters: status, category, search, creatorId
CampaignRepository.updateRaisedAmount(campaignId, amount): Atomic SQL increment of raisedAmount and donorCount

DonationRepository.findByCampaignId(campaignId, page, limit: [Donation[], number]; SUCCESS only; search by donor name
DonationRepository.getDonationChartData(campaignId, days?): Array<{ date, amount, count }> daily via DATE_TRUNC
DonationRepository.getSystemChartData(interval?, days?): Array<{ date, amount, count }> by day|week|month

CommentRepository.hasUserDonatedToCampaign(userId, campaig: boolean — checks via joined Donation with SUCCESS status

WithdrawRepository.findWithPagination(page, limit, filters?: [WithdrawRequest[], number] with campaign + requester + processedBy; filters: status, creatorId
WithdrawRepository.findByCampaignId(campaignId): WithdrawRequest[] PENDING only with campaign + requester
WithdrawRepository.getTotalPaidAmount(campaignId?): number — sum of COMPLETED withdrawals; scoped to campaign if provided

auth.middleware.ts.authenticate: Reads Authorization: Bearer <token>, calls verifyAccessToken, sets req.user; throws 401 if missing or invalid
auth.middleware.ts.optionalAuthenticate: Same as authenticate but silently continues if no token present

role.middleware.ts.requireRoles(...roles): Factory — allows any role in provided list

rateLimiter.middleware.ts.globalRateLimiter: windowMs: RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS (default 900000ms=15min), max: RATE_LIMIT_MAX (default 100); applied app-level
rateLimiter.middleware.ts.authRateLimiter: windowMs: 15min, max: 10; available but not applied in current route files

validate.middleware.ts.validate(schema): Parses req.body with Zod schema; ZodError propagates to errorHandler

upload.middleware.ts.uploadImage: Single field 'avatar'; JPEG/PNG/WEBP/GIF only; used on PUT /users/me
upload.middleware.ts.uploadDocument: Single field 'document'; images + PDF; general utility
upload.middleware.ts.uploadMultiple: Any fields, up to 10 files, image types only; used on POST /campaigns/:id/updates
upload.middleware.ts.uploadCampaignFiles: Fields: thumbnail (×1), media (×10), proofDocuments (×10); images + PDF for proof; used on POST /campaigns/requests

error.middleware.ts.errorHandler: ZodError → 400 with field array; AppError subclass → status+code; uncaught → 500 (message hidden in production)

keyConventions.campaigns:{queryJson}: Serialised campaign list result, TTL 5 min

passport.ts.onSuccess: Delegates to authService.googleLogin(profile); returns token pair as Express.User

sendVerificationEmail.dispatchedBy: available in worker; auth.service calls emailService directly

sendPasswordResetEmail.dispatchedBy: available in worker; auth.service calls emailService directly

sendNewCampaignRequestEmail.warning: Job enqueued but no case in worker switch

sendWithdrawRequestNotification.warning: Job enqueued but no case in worker switch

auth.validator.ts.registerSchema: email valid; password >=8 chars with uppercase+lowercase+digit; fullName 2-100
auth.validator.ts.resetPasswordSchema: token non-empty; password same strength as register

campaign.validator.ts.createCampaignRequestSchema: title 5-100; story >=50; goalAmount >=1000000 VND; deadline future ISO datetime; bankInfo nested object
campaign.validator.ts.reviewCampaignRequestSchema: action: approve|reject; refine: rejectReason required when rejecting
campaign.validator.ts.updateCampaignSchema: story >=50 optional; thumbnailUrl valid URL optional
campaign.validator.ts.campaignQuerySchema: page/limit string->int transforms; sortBy enum; default createdAt DESC
campaign.validator.ts.createCampaignUpdateSchema: title 5-100; content >=10; category UpdateCategory enum; isDraft string flag

donation.validator.ts.createDonationSchema: campaignId UUID; amount >=10000 VND; message <=500; paymentMethod default VNPAY
donation.validator.ts.createCommentSchema: campaignId UUID; content 1-500; emoji optional; isAnonymous optional

user.validator.ts.updateUserProfileSchema: fullName 2-100 optional; phoneNumber Vietnamese regex optional
user.validator.ts.addBankAccountSchema: bankName; accountNumber digits-only; accountHolderName; isDefault default false

withdraw.validator.ts.createWithdrawRequestSchema: campaignId UUID; amount positive; bankAccountId UUID
withdraw.validator.ts.processWithdrawRequestSchema: action: approve|reject; refine: rejectReason required when rejecting

donation.notes: DonationResponseDto.donorDisplayName masked to 'Nhà hảo tâm ẩn danh' when isAnonymous=true; bankAccount shows first 3 digits only

errors.ts.baseClass: AppError extends Error (statusCode, isOperational, optional code)

pagination.ts.getPaginationParams(page, limit): Returns { page, limit, skip }; clamps limit to 1-100
pagination.ts.maskAccountNumber(accountNumber): Shows first 3 chars, replaces rest with *
pagination.ts.formatCurrency(amount): Formats as Vietnamese VND using Intl.NumberFormat

response.ts.sendPaginated(res, data, pagination, mes: 200 { success, message, data, pagination: { total, page, limit, totalPages, hasNext, hasPrev } }

PaginatedResult<T>: pagination: { total, page, limit, totalPages, hasNext, hasPrev }

stages.production: node:20-alpine — npm ci --omit=dev, copy dist/, non-root user nodejs:1001, EXPOSE 3000, healthcheck via wget /health
